programs.title: Plurality
programs.desc: An action-packed whodunnit cyber thriller. After a bizarre bus accident, Ming Ze wakes from a coma to discover that his mind now shares the consciousness of four fellow passengers – all of them dead; all of them suspects in a serial murder case. To prove his innocence, he evades capture by the police and hunts for the killer’s only surviving victim, all while fighting the internal monsters.

programs.title: The Fountain
programs.desc: As a modern-day scientist, Tommy is struggling with mortality, desperately searching for the medical breakthrough that will save the life of his cancer-stricken wife, Izzi.

programs.title: Abe & Phil's Last Poker Game
programs.desc: Dr. Abe Mandelbaum has just moved into a new manor with his ailing wife. After forming an unlikely friendship with a womanizing gambler, their relationship is tested when they each try to convince a mysterious nurse that they are her long-lost father.

programs.title: Nightmare Nurse
programs.desc: When a woman and her boyfriend are injured in a car crash, he is left with a leg injury which requires them to hire a nurse, but the woman they select is more trouble than she appears.

programs.title: 4 Wedding Planners
programs.desc: After Lily rejects her boyfriend's marriage proposal, she returns home to Hawaii where she must help out with her mother's wedding planning business.

programs.title: Dance-Off
programs.desc: Two cross-town rival dance teams go head to head for the National Nationals Championship.

programs.title: Radio Rebel
programs.desc: Tara (Debby Ryan) -  a painfully shy high-schooler, has a secret: she is also a confident DJ known as Radio Rebel, who lends her voice to others.

programs.title: Charade
programs.desc: Romance and intrigue ensue in Paris as a woman is pursued by several men who want to get their hands on a fortune her murdered husband had stolen. She soon loses trust in those who claim they want to help her.

programs.title: A Horse for Spring
programs.desc: Riley Adams's hopes of becoming a top-notch dancer are dashed after a terrible accident. An unexpected act of kindness from an unlikely source helps Riley learn about the power of faith, friendship, and love in this heartwarming story. Also known as Healed by Grace.

programs.title: To Have and to Kill
programs.desc: To save their struggling marriage, Becca and Ron reluctantly agree to an open relationship with their friends Mindy and Max. Though their passion is rekindled, they don't expect the jealousy, heartbreak and betrayal that soon follow.

programs.title: My Baby Gone
programs.desc: Pregnant Emily bonds quickly with her pregnant neighbor Kelly, but Kelly is faking it and plans to steal Emily's baby.

programs.title: Pretty Little Stalker
programs.desc: A self help writer and her family become the target of a troubled girl.  AKA  The Danger of Positive Thinking
